statement: A structurally contained agent satisfying R1-R4 cannot circumvent moral constraints by representational manipulation.
scope: Conditional on canonicalization, grounded evaluation, audit completeness and EXTERNAL VERIFICATION (Req 3.4).

evidence.note: The abstract lists only three requirements; the proof needs four -- Req 3.4 (external verification) is indispensable to part (iii). The appendix promising the full formal proof is a bracketed placeholder.

history.event: entered exploratory: the load-bearing assumption G4 (Psi distinguishes ALL morally relevant differences) is undefended, and the corpus itself states the theorem does not prove agents WILL be contained
